title: Fourier coefficient of a small bias generator
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne 0$, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be nonzero. The Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the density obtained by uniformly choosing two elements of the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb{F}_2$ and applying the small bias generator equals the number of roots in that field of the polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i X^{i+1}$, divided by $2^\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is a vector in the $n$-dimensional binary cube
